description: Two outlined figures interlock in a vertical acrobatic balance, with their circular heads staggered on the right. Bent limbs project left while the upper body curves upward above the supporting figure.
Two figures overlap in a compact partner balance, with one head low on the left and the other near the center. Their bent bodies form opposing hooked silhouettes, with a folded figure above.
Two figures stack horizontally with their round heads on the left. The lower figure forms a supported bridge with downward limbs, while the upper figure arches across its back.
An inverted figure hangs head downward between two upward suspension lines. Its arms spread diagonally beside the head, while bent legs wrap outward around the upper fabric support.
A side-view football helmet faces right, with a broad domed shell and recessed face opening. A curved faceguard projects from the opening and a circular ear detail marks the lower shell.
A running figure bends both legs in opposing directions and swings one arm forward. The other arm wraps around a small ball tucked against the side of the torso.
A figure runs with one arm stretched left and the other curled around a ball against the right side. One leg extends down-left while the other bends back upward.
A smoothly curved bow opens toward the left, with its middle crossed by a straight horizontal arrow. The arrow extends beyond the bow toward a pointed head on the right.
An athlete rises beside a long bowed pole curving from upper left to lower right. The hands reach up to the pole and both legs bend beneath the leaning torso.
A runner leans forward toward the right with one arm bent ahead and the other swept back. The legs separate into a forward bent stride and a raised rear foot.
A long baseball bat tilts from lower left to upper right, widening toward its rounded barrel. A narrow grip ends in a projecting knob, with a round ball beside the upper-left space.
A single bent arm forms a flexed biceps silhouette, with a curled fist raised on the left. The elbow rounds across the bottom and a large muscle bulges on the right.
A cyclist leans forward above two separate circular wheels, with bent arms reaching toward the right. The angular torso and lowered bent leg suggest pedaling without a fully drawn bicycle frame.
A tall punching bag hangs below a triangular suspension strap and narrow collar. Its body widens at the shoulders and ends in a smooth rounded bottom.
A boxer stands in a wide staggered stance beside a hanging cylindrical bag on the right. One gloved arm extends straight toward the bag while the torso leans into the punch.
A front-facing padded headguard has a broad brow band and rounded crown. Deep cheek pads curve inward around a large face opening, joining a rounded protective edge below.
A backpacked figure raises one knee beside a jagged rock face on the right. One arm reaches toward the cliff while the other bends near the shoulder above the extended supporting leg.
A figure with raised arms hangs beside a rope curving upward on the right. A horizontal harness crosses the waist, with one leg extended down-left and the other bent outward.
A figure lunges with the front knee bent at a right angle and the rear leg extended diagonally backward. One arm rises overhead while the other follows the side of the upright torso.
A cricket bat tilts upward to the right with a broad flat blade and a narrower straight handle. A small round ball floats in the open space beside its upper-left side.
A curled figure reclines beneath two sloping suspension lines, with its circular head on the left. The torso and raised bent limbs form a compact upward-facing shape between the straps.
A sleeveless ballet dress has narrow shoulder straps, a notched neckline, and a fitted waist. The skirt spreads broadly into a tutu with a softly scalloped lower hem.
An athlete twists in a wide stepping stance with one arm extended diagonally to the right. The opposite arm bends back on the left, holding a small round discus beside the head.
A thick circular weight plate appears in oblique view as a broad oval disk. A curved interior edge shows its depth, and a horizontal bar projects from both sides.
An upright forearm ends in a fist wrapped around the center of a horizontal dumbbell. Four rounded knuckles sit above the grip, between two tall rectangular end weights.
A horizontal dumbbell has two compact rounded rectangular weights joined by a straight central bar. Short exposed tips extend beyond the outside edges of the matching end weights.
A straight horizontal bar links two tall rounded rectangular weights of equal size. The bar extends a little beyond both outer faces, giving the dumbbell a balanced bilateral shape.
Three horizontal dumbbells are stacked vertically, increasing in size toward the bottom. Each has paired rounded end weights connected by a straight bar with short projecting outer tips.
A front-facing fencer bust wears a round mesh mask divided by horizontal and vertical bars. A long foil rises diagonally at the right, with a curved guard beside the shoulder.
A fencer lunges left with a long straight foil extended at shoulder height. The other arm bends upward behind the body, and the legs spread into a deep opposing stance.
A rider bends forward above two circular bicycle wheels, with a bent arm reaching a short handlebar. A sloping front fork joins the handlebar to the right wheel.
A side-view bicycle has two round wheels, a low sloping frame, and a short horizontal saddle. The front fork rises to a bent handlebar, leaving an open step-through space above the frame.
A side-view bicycle has two equal round wheels connected by a triangular frame. A short saddle rises above the rear wheel and a bent handlebar sits above the front fork.
A horizontal dumbbell has a short thick grip joining two upright weight plates. Smaller end caps project beyond the plates, with the left plate shown slightly turned in perspective.
A front-facing athlete holds a rope out to both sides while lifting one bent knee. The rope curves downward in a broad loop beneath the suspended feet.
A jump rope arches upward between two matching vertical handles. The long cord forms a smooth inverted U, and both cylindrical handles have softly rounded lower ends.
A front-facing figure holds both ends of a jump rope near hip height. One leg lifts across the other while the rope forms a rounded loop beneath the body.
A cropped torso narrows at the waist above a curved waistband. Two opposing columns of rounded muscle segments mark the abdomen, leaving a narrow vertical gap between them.
A horizontal dumbbell consists of two narrow rounded end weights linked by a straight bar. Small bar tips project past the weights on both sides of the balanced silhouette.
A football player spreads both arms while swinging one leg back and bending the other forward. A small round ball lies directly below the body between the legs.
A rectangular goal mouth recedes inward along sloping side and top edges. A square mesh spans the back, with lower net strands hanging toward the open ground edge.
A front-facing goal has a broad rectangular frame with rounded top corners and two extended posts. A regular grid of square net openings fills the space inside.
An open padded glove tilts from lower left to upper right, with four long separated fingers and an outward thumb. A broad straight cuff wraps around its wrist.
A compact golf cart faces right beneath a long flat canopy with rounded ends. Two wheels sit below an open passenger area, rear seat, and curved front body.
A triangular flag rises from an oval golf hole on the left. A long leaning club stands to the right, with its curved head beside a small ball near the bottom.
A tall straight pole rises from a flattened oval golf hole. A triangular pennant projects to the right near the top, while the pole continues into the hole.
An upright triangular flag marks an irregular rounded golf green. The green broadens into a smaller connected lobe on the right, and its outline opens near the flagpole.
A golfer twists with bent knees and crossed raised arms in front of the upper torso. The club shaft extends diagonally above the head to a small curved head at the upper left.
A round kettlebell has a short squared handle rising from its upper shoulders. A small rectangular opening separates the grip from the body, and a curved highlight follows the lower-left surface.
Two running figures move side by side, with one slightly behind and to the left. Both have circular heads, bent swinging arms, and legs separated into active strides.
Two long padded handles angle downward and outward from a circular spring at the top. Narrow connecting arms join the handles to the round coil, leaving an open triangular gap.
A side-view sports helmet faces right with a rounded shell, circular ear opening, and short projecting visor. A recessed face opening curves into a protective lower section at the front.
A long hockey stick leans upward to the right, ending in a curved blade that extends left along the bottom. A small circular puck sits separately beside the lower shaft.
An athlete holds a long javelin overhead, angled upward toward the right. Both arms bend around the head while the legs spread into a wide forward throwing stride.
A runner leans left with one knee raised and the opposite leg stretched diagonally behind. Three short horizontal motion strokes trail to the right of the bent arms and torso.
A martial artist balances on one upright leg while the other extends in a high diagonal kick toward the upper right. Bent arms guard the leaning torso beneath the round head.
A skier leans back on two short upturned skis while reaching toward a kite above the right side. An angular tether connects the hands to the curved triangular kite.
A front-facing athlete lifts both arms in celebration while crossing a broad horizontal finish ribbon. The ribbon passes across the waist, with two straight legs continuing below.
A martial artist stands with legs spread and knees bent, turning the torso slightly to the right. One arm guards across the chest while the other bends upward in front.
An oval protective mask has a thick outer rim surrounding a face grille of horizontal bars and a central vertical divider. Two broad protective flaps spread from its lower sides.
A domed protective hood surrounds a narrow oval face opening crossed by three horizontal bars. Its lower edge spreads outward into three rounded protective lobes beneath the face.
A running athlete holds a flaming torch upright in the forward hand on the right. The other arm swings back while the legs separate into a long stride beneath the torso.
A large circular exercise ball is divided by two sweeping curved surface lines. The curves run from the upper edge toward the lower left, suggesting the round volume of the ball.
An athlete leans toward a table edge on the right, holding a small oval paddle in a bent forward arm. A small ball hangs just above the table beside the player.
A running player moves toward a round ball at the lower right. One leg bends backward, the other drops forward, and both arms curve outward to balance the stride.
A player swings one leg backward and bends the other beside a small ball below the body. One arm extends left while the opposite arm lifts upward to the right.
An upright football player raises one arm and lowers the other beside the torso. One knee bends toward a ball at the lower left while the opposite leg remains extended.
A circular pool ball has a smaller round number panel centered inside it. The panel carries an upright numeral eight, with the broad surrounding area forming the ball surface.
A standing figure holds a long cue angled upward beside a cropped pool table on the right. The table has a thick horizontal rail and two visible supporting legs.
A pool player bends forward with legs spread, bringing both arms across the body. A long cue crosses the hands diagonally from upper left toward lower right.
A rectangular pool table is seen from above with pocket shapes at its four corners and the centers of its long sides. A cue crosses diagonally over the lower-right edge.
A rounded triangular rack encloses three round pool balls arranged with one above two. The balls touch near the center, and their lower outlines are slightly flattened by the compact grouping.
A cyclist crouches over two large circular wheels, with the torso rounded forward and arms reaching right. One bent leg descends toward the rear wheel and the front fork slopes beneath the hands.
A front-facing wheelchair racer raises both arms while wearing a medal on a V-shaped ribbon. Two slanted outer wheels flank a narrow central wheel below the seated torso.
A seated racer faces forward with arms curving down toward the sides of a racing wheelchair. Two outward-leaning wheels flank a long central wheel beneath the rounded torso.
A gymnast balances with one leg bent backward and one arm raised overhead. A long ribbon arcs above the head and curls into a loose loop on the left.
A figure runs toward the right with bent arms and widely separated legs. A short undulating ribbon trails above the rear shoulder on the left, separate from the body outline.
A gymnast stands with one arm raised and one leg bent outward to the right. A broad ribbon sweeps almost completely around the body in a large open circular curve.
A skater leans forward with arms extending in opposite directions and one leg lifted behind. Small wheel marks sit beneath the raised rear skate and the grounded front skate.
A tall ankle boot faces right with a rounded toe and a short upper fastening line. Four circular inline wheels sit directly beneath the long flat sole.
A close view shows a running shoe angled down against a triangular starting block. The toe meets a straight ground line, and two short lace marks cross the instep.
A runner crouches low with the head at the upper left and one long arm reaching to the ground. One knee tucks beneath the torso while the rear leg extends diagonally backward.
A rounded rectangular scoreboard hangs from two short upright tabs crossing its top edge. The face displays a large 2:0 score, with the colon centered between the numbers.
A broad rounded rectangular scoreboard stands on two narrow vertical posts. The face contains a large 2:0 score, arranged centrally with a colon separating the opposing numbers.
A shooter stands with legs spread and shoulders turned right, holding a rifle at shoulder height. Both bent arms support the long horizontal weapon as its barrel points right.
A long rifle lies diagonally from lower left to upper right, with a shaped stock and narrow barrel. Two circular bullseye targets occupy opposite corners beside the weapon.
A human-shaped target has a round head above broad rounded shoulders and straight open-bottom sides. A concentric circular bullseye is centered on the chest of the silhouette.
A cropped muscular torso shows paired pectoral curves above two rows of curved abdominal marks. The sides taper toward the waist, with a small vertical navel mark near the bottom.
A skateboarder holds both arms straight out to the sides while bending one leg and extending the other backward. A short horizontal board with two visible wheels supports the lowered foot.
A skateboarder stretches both arms outward while one knee bends above a small wheeled board. The other leg reaches diagonally down-left beside the board in a pushing stance.
A long shallow skateboard deck curves gently upward at both ends. Two separate circular wheels sit beneath the otherwise straight lower edge, shown in a simple side view.
A tall skate boot faces right, with a sloping ankle opening and rounded toe. Two short supports connect the flat sole to a long rounded ice blade beneath.
A figure balances with arms spread and one bent knee on a rising curved board. Two low wave crests sit beneath the board, showing the rider above a water surface.
A seated-looking figure leans back with one arm extended horizontally to the right. A bent lower limb rests above a long curved ski-like stroke, forming a low gliding posture.
A ski jumper leans far forward above a long ski angled upward to the right. The body forms a narrow bent silhouette behind the round head, and the ski tip curls upward.
A seated rider leans forward to grasp the handlebar of a ski bike. A low seat and two separated upturned runners support the bent legs and compact angled frame.
A snowboarder bends both knees above a long board tilted downward to the right. The arms stretch in opposing directions, with the left arm lifted and the right arm lowered.
Two riders sit one behind the other inside a long rounded bobsled body. Short supports connect the enclosed shell to a straight runner with an upturned front tip.
A skier sits with knees bent and skis extending forward beneath the feet. A vertical suspension support rises beside the seated body, while the arms rest across the lap.
A seated passenger hangs below a long sloping overhead cable on a short vertical support. The body curves into a seated profile, with the knees bent and feet hanging down.
A rider lies face down along a narrow sled sloping toward the lower right. The head leads on the right, while the body extends left with the feet lifted slightly upward.
A skier strides forward with the front knee bent and rear leg stretched back. A pole stands beside the forward hand, while a second trailing pole and upturned skis follow the movement.
A tall ankle boot faces right with a broad rounded toe and squared upper opening. Two vertical mounts join its sole to a long ice blade whose front end curls upward.
A long upright ski with a rounded tip stands between two matching poles. Two chevron-like markings cross the ski, and each pole has an elongated grip and a small basket near its tip.
A skier crouches deeply with the torso leaning downhill toward the right. One arm folds behind the shoulder while the other lowers forward above a long ski with an upturned tip.
A standing rider bends both knees and reaches forward to a tall angled handlebar. A long runner supports the feet and curves upward at its front end on the right.
A skier follows a horse facing right, with an arm extended toward the horse through a short tether. The skier stands on a low ski behind the horse's upright legs and arched neck.
A snowboarder is airborne with both arms spread wide and one knee lifted. A separate broad board with rounded ends rises diagonally below the feet from lower left to upper right.
A snowboarder rides a short upturned board above a curved ramp rising toward the right. One arm reaches overhead while the other extends backward to balance the bent-legged stance.
An upright goalkeeper glove has four rounded fingers and a thumb projecting to the left. The broad palm narrows into a rectangular wrist cuff, with finger divisions extending downward.
A skater leans sharply forward with one arm bent behind the shoulder and the rear leg stretched back. Three short motion lines trail left, while the front foot rests on a curved blade.
A horizontal barbell rests between two tall vertical supports, with matching weights at its ends. A tapered bench seat stands below the center on two short legs.
A curling athlete lunges with one leg extended back and the torso leaning left. A long broom slopes down from the hands to a flattened oval head near the ground.
A golf club shaft rises diagonally to the upper right from a broad curved head. A round ball on a short tee sits immediately below the head, above a small ground stroke.
A rider leans forward over the handlebar of an exercise bicycle, with one bent leg reaching toward the pedal area. A broad enclosed base forms the stationary machine beneath the body.
A hockey player bends forward with both hands holding a long angled stick. The stick's curved blade approaches a small puck at the lower right as the legs spread for balance.
A helmeted rider leans forward over a horse facing right. The horse has a pointed muzzle and raised neck, while the rider's bent leg hangs beside its body and the tail curves left.
A runner moves right with one arm bent forward and the other swept backward. The torso leans slightly, one leg reaches behind, and the other bends downward into the next stride.
A prone pilot hangs beneath a long triangular wing pointing toward the right. A short support joins the wing to the body, whose arms extend forward and legs trail left.
A running figure raises the forward forearm while the opposite arm bends back. The circular head sits above a leaning torso, with one leg kicked behind and the other bent downward.
A runner strides on a long treadmill belt with bent arms held in front of the torso. An angled upright support and short console rise from the machine's right end.
A long rounded treadmill base supports two angled uprights at the right end. A horizontal handrail projects left from the top, with a short raised console edge on the right.
A sprinter leans left with one arm reaching forward and the other bent behind the shoulder. The front knee folds upward while the rear leg extends diagonally back to the right.
A broad sumo wrestler faces forward with arms spread and knees bent outward. A topknot rises above the head, and a wide belt with a central front panel wraps the waist.
A front-facing head wears a smooth rounded swimming cap around the forehead and ears. Simple curved eyes, a short nose, and a smiling mouth mark the exposed face.
A tall diving tower on the left supports two projecting platforms at different heights. A curved brace joins the upper platform to the tower, and a wavy waterline runs beside its base.
A diver slopes headfirst toward a wavy waterline at the lower right. The streamlined body bends at the hips, with the legs lifted diagonally behind toward the upper left.
Two wide oval swimming lenses sit side by side, connected by a short narrow bridge. Their matching rounded rims form a horizontally balanced outline with empty lens interiors.
A figure springs from a low pool edge with both knees tucked and one arm raised behind the head. The stepped edge ends beside a short wavy water surface.
A lifeguard sits in profile on a tall chair with ladder-like crossbars below the seat. Bent legs extend toward the right above two rows of waves beside the chair.
A player rises from a wavy waterline with one arm lifted diagonally overhead. A round ball rests above the raised hand while the other arm bends beside the torso.
A swimmer's round head and bent arm rise above two broad wave lines. The upper arm lifts behind the head and the forearm reaches forward close to the water surface.
A long straight fencing foil runs diagonally from lower left to upper right. A curved semicircular guard separates the short handle below from the slender blade above.
Two long straight swords cross diagonally in an X, with their blunt-tipped blades rising toward opposite upper corners. Short crossguards and handles extend toward the lower corners.
A tennis player bends the knees and holds a raised oval racket with both hands in front of the torso. A small ball approaches from the right beside the racket.
A tennis player steps forward with one knee bent and a racket extended toward the upper left. A small ball sits below the racket while the free arm curves beside the torso.
An oval tennis racket angles from its long lower-left grip toward the upper right. A small round ball floats beside its upper-left edge, and an open throat joins the handle to the head.
A long narrow handle rises diagonally into an oval tennis racket head at the upper right. A small open triangular throat joins the grip to the otherwise empty head.
A round paddle head joins a broad short handle angled toward the lower left. A separate circular ball sits beside the upper-left edge of the plain unstrung paddle face.
A short-handled paddle tilts diagonally upward to the right, with a broad circular face. A small ball occupies the open upper-left corner beside the paddle's rounded head.
A circular stopwatch has a short vertical stem and flat push button at the top. A single diagonal hand extends from near the center toward the upper right.
A round volleyball is divided into broad curved panels that meet near the center. Several parallel seam curves sweep around the surface, wrapping the distinct panel groups around the ball.
A wide rectangular mesh hangs between two tall upright posts with short flat feet. Two horizontal bands and regular vertical divisions create a grid across the upper portion.
A volleyball player jumps with one arm raised overhead and the other stretched left. One leg bends backward while a large round ball hangs at the upper left beside the head.
A horizontal barbell with rounded end weights rests across two tall narrow uprights. A small rounded bench seat stands below the bar on two outward-sloping legs.
A front-facing athlete lifts a barbell overhead with both arms extended upward. The bar bows gently between matching tilted end weights, above a straight torso and separated legs.
A standing athlete faces forward with both arms lowered to a horizontal barbell at hip height. Long vertical end plates flank the body, whose legs remain close together beneath the bar.
An inverted figure hangs head downward with arms spread beside the head. A rounded triangular fabric seat supports the hips, and two suspension lines extend upward toward opposite corners.
Two wrestlers face each other with bent knees and wide stances. Their outstretched arms meet and overlap at the center, forming a mutual grip between the leaning bodies.
An oval wrestling mask has angled eye openings beneath a wavy forehead band. A broad rounded mouth panel occupies the lower face, with a short horizontal mouth opening inside.
A wrestling mask has two tall pointed upper corners and a deep V-shaped forehead edge. Slanted eye openings, a curved mouth mark, and a short chin seam define the face.
A seated figure crosses both legs in front of the torso and raises both arms in a broad curve overhead. The circular head sits between the open ends of the arms.
A balancing figure bends the torso forward with one arm extending horizontally to the right. One knee folds high beside the body while the supporting leg drops straight downward.
A folded figure stretches a long limb horizontally to the left above its lowered round head. The torso bends sharply down at the right and ends in a short outward-curving support.
A figure balances on one vertical leg while the torso, arms, and raised rear leg form a long horizontal span. The lowered head peeks beneath the left side of the outstretched body.
A seated figure leans back while lifting the legs diagonally upward to the right. The arms reach forward above the legs, forming a compact open V around the bent torso.
A reclining figure raises the hips into a curved bridge with the head low on the right. A bent supporting leg drops underneath while another long limb extends diagonally toward the upper left.
A kneeling figure arches the torso backward above folded lower legs. One long arm reaches down toward the heels, and the round head sits above the curved chest on the right.
A narrow side-view figure bends both knees while raising the arms straight overhead. The torso stays lifted above the shallow seated bend, with the head beside the upper arms.
A prone figure stretches the legs left along the ground while lifting the chest and head on the right. A straight supporting arm descends below the shoulder beside the upward-curving torso.
A compact figure balances forward with a long arm extending down beneath the shoulder. The round head projects left while bent knees tuck toward the body at the upper right.
A figure forms a high inverted V with the hips lifted and limbs sloping down to either side. A short curved head outline sits above the low extended forearms on the left.
A figure lifts the hips into a broad inverted V with straight legs on the left and extended arms on the right. The round head hangs beneath the sloping torso near the arms.
A standing figure raises both arms in a wide rounded arc around the head. One leg remains straight while the other bends outward, opening a narrow triangular gap below the torso.
A figure balances on a downward arm and bent supporting leg beneath a horizontal torso. The other leg extends diagonally upward to the right, while the head projects left.
A low figure holds the body nearly straight on a shallow diagonal, with the head at the right. A bent arm supports the shoulder while the long legs extend back to the left.
A figure sits upright with two crossed legs beneath a rounded torso. Both arms curve inward toward the abdomen, leaving a small central gap below the circular head.
A front-facing figure sits with crossed legs and an upright rounded torso. Straight arms rest down beside the body, and the circular head is separated slightly above the shoulders.
A cross-legged figure holds both hands together in a pointed prayer shape at the center of the chest. Rounded bent arms enclose the hands beneath a separate circular head.
A figure sits upright with the legs crossed broadly in front. The arms extend down along the rounded torso, while a plain circular head sits centered above the shoulders.
A narrow standing figure extends the arms straight upward beside the head. The long torso and joined legs form one continuous upright silhouette with a softly rounded bottom.
A front-facing figure stands upright with the feet together and arms resting down beside the torso. The body has rounded shoulders and a separate circular head centered above.
A low seated figure folds the rounded back over the legs and stretches both arms forward along the ground to the left. The lowered circular head sits just above the extended arms.
A standing figure stretches both arms horizontally at shoulder height. The legs spread into a wide stance with one knee bent, beneath a straight torso and centered circular head.
A standing figure folds deeply at the hips into a tall rounded arch. Long arms descend beside the legs, and the circular head hangs outside the lower-right side of the folded torso.
A tall figure raises both arms in a wide V beside a smaller crouched figure on the left. The smaller figure spreads its arms and bends both knees outward.
A seated figure leans backward with both arms reaching diagonally up-right and the legs lifted in the same direction. The curved lower torso forms the base of an open V-shaped balance.
A figure balances on one straight leg while the opposite foot rests against its inner side, forming a triangular knee opening. Both arms curve overhead around the circular head.
A wide-legged figure bends the torso sideways, reaching one arm down between the legs. The other arm rises diagonally overhead, with the circular head beside the tilted upper body.
A figure lunges with one bent front knee and the rear leg extended diagonally left. Both arms reach vertically overhead beside the head, lengthening the upright torso.
A figure stands in a broad lunge with one knee bent and the other leg stretched diagonally outward. Both arms extend horizontally from the shoulders beneath the centered circular head.
